title: Gravitational-wave parameter estimation with machine-learning generated surrogate waveforms
abstract: arXiv:2608.20222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The worldwide network of gravitational-wave detectors have detected more than 350 binary coalescence events till date. Future third-generation detectors, like Einstein telescope, are expected to detect orders-of-magnitude more signals from sources with more complicated characteristics, including eccentric orbits and high-mass ratio binaries. It is well-established that the computational cost of parameter estimation for signals from these kinds of sources will be extremely high. In particular, the process could be sped-up if generating theoretical waveform predictions, used for likelihood calculation becomes faster. Recently, various machine-learning techniques has been proposed to this end. translated_title: 基于机器学习生成替代波形的引力波参数估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20222v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：全球引力波探测器网络迄今已探测到超过350次双星并合事件。未来的第三代探测器，如爱因斯坦望远镜，预计将探测到数量级更多的信号，这些信号来自具有更复杂特性的源，包括偏心轨道和高质量比双星。众所周知，对这些源产生的信号进行参数估计的计算成本将极其高昂。特别是，如果用于似然计算的理论波形预测生成速度加快，该过程可以加速。近年来，各种机器学习技术已被提出用于此目的。在本工作中，我们提出了一种两阶段确定性条件自编码器模型，用于生成四参数SEOBNRv4波形。模型的第一阶段生成波形的振幅和相位序列，而第二阶段校准这些序列。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段机器学习模型来快速生成引力波替代波形，显著加速参数估计过程，适用于未来第三代探测器的高计算成本场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage machine-learning model to rapidly generate surrogate gravitational waveforms, significantly accelerating parameter estimation for future third-generation detectors with high computational costs.
